flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty), App.tsx (index route), utils/data/LinkData.tsx (Work Items and UPL menus commented out), utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, pages/Report/action/ActionReport.tsx; ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/filedownload/downloadfile/FileDownloadController (POST download/blob); ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItemFor... placeholder), workflows/hstreport/services/HstReportServiceImpl (reports by email). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Status sheet: Demo paid (50% of 75%); no separate requirement is given (story text only). A staff dashboard page exists but is empty (Dashboard.tsx:26-29). There is no summary of notifications/alerts, per-OIC pending work items or routed reports; the Work Items menu is commented out and backend work item creation is a placeholder. Only separate mechanisms exist: the Furnished Hirer/Driver queue and the Report page with download, neither being a 'single-page summary' on the dashboard. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict (OCMS-SR-2026-016 and OCMS-DF-2026-104 only concern report email distribution). Real environment values cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the empty dashboard page shell and the Report page can be reused; the notification summary, pending work items, routed reports and click-through to a work item do not exist. Ask URA whether the paid demo refers to another build.

steps.step: The logged-in officer lands on the OCMS dashboard page
steps.detail: Index and wildcard routes (App.tsx:79 and :81) open the Dashboard component after login, so a dashboard page exists. But the component is empty: Dashboard.tsx:26-29 is only a DataForm holding one empty row div. Staff login/authentication was not examined here (cannot verify from repo).

steps.step: The dashboard shows a single-page summary of notifications/alerts
steps.detail: No code reads or shows officer notifications/alerts. Dashboard.tsx:26-29 is empty. On the API side there is no officer notification entity or endpoint: 'notification' in ocmsadminapi only covers eNotification/SMS/email to offenders (OcmsSmsNotificationRecords.java:23) and technical error emails (ErrorNotificationAspect.java:18-28). Synonyms notification, alert, inbox, unread were tried in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi: no match.

steps.step: The dashboard shows a summary of pending work items routed to the officer
steps.detail: The Work Items menu is commented out: '// menu.push(LinkWorkItem)' (LinkData.tsx:398, under '//! UNCONFIRMED' :396). utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts:1-12 only holds the path '/work-item' and App.tsx has no Route for it. Backend work item creation is also a placeholder: DataHiveUenFinService.createWorkItemForPRSC (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2923) and every other createWorkItemFor... method only log '[PLACEHOLDER] ... feature not ready' (e.g. :3042-3045, :3225-3228, :3697-3700); the comment at :2907-2912 names ocms_work_item / _allocation / _notices but no entity or repository for those tables exists in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. The only 'pending' queue in the staff portal is the Furnished Hirer/Driver list (status P, FurnishSummaryList.tsx:60, route App.tsx:192-193), a separate menu page, not a per-OIC summary on the dashboard.

steps.step: The dashboard shows reports routed to the officer for follow-up
steps.detail: There is no per-officer report list on the dashboard. Reports built by cron are sent as email attachments to a distribution list, for example HstReportServiceImpl.sendHstWorkItemsReportEmail (HstReportServiceImpl.java:338, :367), not routed to an officer dashboard. Maintenance tickets OCMS-SR-2026-016 (add users to the Daily/Monthly Paid Report distribution list) and OCMS-DF-2026-104 (duplicate report emails) show distribution is by email.

steps.step: The officer clicks into a work item from the dashboard
steps.detail: The dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:26-29) so there is nothing to click. Detail pages reachable from other lists (e.g. the notice link in FurnishSummaryList.tsx:97-101) are not a click from the dashboard.

steps.step: The officer can download the reports routed to them
steps.detail: Report download exists but through the Report menu, not the dashboard: the Report menu (LinkData.tsx:58-62, pushed at :390) opens report pages with an Export button (ActionReport.tsx:226-228), and report files can be fetched with POST download/blob (FileDownloadController.java:114). This is a generic mechanism for all reports, not reports routed to a specific officer. Some reports have no blob download (see addendum note: OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER).
